product_thesis: Turn repeated agent failures into evidence-backed capability changes.

last_closed_goal.title: Replace the provisional normalizer with an exact KAE exporter
last_closed_goal.summary: KAE now publishes an exact trajectory exporter and EvoGen consumes its strict current envelope, retiring the broad aliasing normalizer while retaining fixture-only historical diagnosis evidence.

current_focus.title: Register KAE as an EvoGen subject plugin
current_focus.summary: The optional KAE subject plugin remains the next unstarted packet. The replay showcase and any evolved capability remain withheld.

execution_route.label: Real KAE replay showcase
execution_route.delivers: A real KAE bundle flowing through the public EvoGen path with raw and normalized events, provenance, receipt versus later outcome, and metric equivalence visible in one reusable cockpit.
execution_route.boundary: Portable and replay proof only. No evolved or live-proven KAE capability is claimed.

execution_route.label: One historical evolution
execution_route.delivers: One sealed historical KAE deficit carried through diagnosis, investigation, specification, isolated implementation, independent evaluation, and retained EvoGen lineage.
execution_route.boundary: Historical portable and replay evidence is not a newly discovered or live-proven capability.

execution_route.label: One supervised live evolution
execution_route.delivers: A current supervised KAE observation that may proceed through approved installation, live variants, regressions, long-run evidence, and rollback to a retention decision.
execution_route.boundary: A dispatch, native acknowledgement, receipt, or process exit never substitutes for later world evidence.

execution_route.label: Deferred scientific depth
execution_route.delivers: A diverse sealed corpus, blind deterministic benchmark, and approved model-versus-human diagnosis study with all transcripts and failures retained.
execution_route.boundary: Deferred means later in the proof-first route, not optional; OpenTTD remains blocked until this branch closes.

execution_route.label: OpenTTD and release
execution_route.delivers: A pinned headless second subject, a retained OpenTTD capability change, two-subject genericity, and a release audit.
execution_route.boundary: The local OpenTTD installation is availability evidence only; subject and release claims begin only after both KAE branches close.

trajectory_export_proof.title: Exact KAE events now cross one owned boundary
trajectory_export_proof.scope: KAE commit 548658c owns normalization; EvoGen only verifies and reads the strict exported envelope.
trajectory_export_proof.boundary: Receipt and later outcome remain separate. The historical soak proves exporter compatibility with an explicitly supplied manifest, not its original generation identity or a live world effect. G15 registration, G16 replay, and G17 metric equivalence remain unstarted.

proof_lanes.label: Source
proof_lanes.description: The authority exists in reviewed code or a checked-in contract.

proof_lanes.label: Static tests
proof_lanes.description: Automated tests exercise the contract without claiming an external effect.

proof_lanes.label: Portable
proof_lanes.description: A clean locked verifier reproduces the result from the repository.

proof_lanes.label: Replay
proof_lanes.description: Recorded evidence can reconstruct the relevant choice or outcome.

proof_lanes.label: Hosted CI
proof_lanes.description: The public commit passes its hosted test matrix.

proof_lanes.label: Built artifact
proof_lanes.description: An artifact was built and identified; loading is not implied.

proof_lanes.label: Installed artifact
proof_lanes.description: Installed bytes were independently identified; runtime use is not implied.

proof_lanes.label: Live effect
proof_lanes.description: Later independent engine evidence attests a world effect.

proof_lanes.label: Withheld
proof_lanes.description: The evidence does not support this claim yet.

repositories.name: EvoGen
repositories.state: G01–G08 complete; G14 candidate pending root ratchet

capabilities.name: Deterministic evolution cycle
capabilities.plain_language: Runs an intentionally limited agent, finds a repeated missing capability, generates real plugin code, challenges it across four suites, and retains it only when the evidence clears every gate.
capabilities.not_proven: The reference diagnostician is deterministic; arbitrary model diagnosis is not proven.

capabilities.name: Persisted, resumable orchestration
capabilities.plain_language: Stores typed stage receipts and immutable artifacts so a completed stage can be resumed without silently rerunning prior work.
capabilities.not_proven: Instruction-level crash recovery inside an unfinished stage is not claimed.

capabilities.name: Subject plugin and conformance doctor
capabilities.plain_language: Discovers subjects without importing demo ontology into the generic core and checks their manifests, isolation, symmetry, and retained-generation materialization.
capabilities.not_proven: A passing doctor is additional evidence, not certification of a live environment.

capabilities.name: Frozen evaluator and candidate isolation
capabilities.plain_language: Candidate authors cannot rewrite their evaluator, scenario authority, or baseline. Rejected work remains in lineage rather than disappearing.
capabilities.not_proven: The deterministic demo does not establish model-generated candidate quality.

capabilities.name: KAE event authority and sequence
capabilities.plain_language: KAE has an audited event surface and a monotonic event sequence, closing the identity ambiguity that blocked faithful trajectory import.
capabilities.not_proven: An event inventory and sequence do not by themselves prove what a planner received; the separate G12 event supplies that evidence.

capabilities.name: Exact KAE generation manifest
capabilities.plain_language: Publishes a stable, redacted identity for KAE source and runtime authorities, including independent built, staged, and installed native-artifact evidence.
capabilities.not_proven: File identity does not prove that a DLL is loaded, a process matches it, or a world effect occurred.

capabilities.name: Exact KAE affordance-set event
capabilities.plain_language: Records the exact semantic choices delivered to each hosted planner, including source completeness and typed withholding, then reconstructs selections without parsing prompts or labels.
capabilities.not_proven: Delivery is not selection, dispatch, completion, or a world effect; the real pre-G12 live reporting fixture still truthfully contains no such event.

capabilities.name: Generated KAE capability manifest
capabilities.plain_language: Publishes 69 KAE capabilities from their real operation, native, protocol, service, and proof owners, including one unsupported threat-response boundary that KAE does not pretend to satisfy.
capabilities.not_proven: This is an evidence-backed inventory, not proof that every operation works live or that KAE is already registered as an EvoGen subject.

capabilities.name: Exact KAE trajectory export
capabilities.plain_language: KAE now owns a strict, content-addressed raw-to-normalized boundary. EvoGen reads the exported envelope without guessing aliases, identities, order, or world effects.
capabilities.not_proven: This proves contract compatibility and replay preparation, not KAE subject registration, a public replay run, metric equivalence, an evolved capability, or a live world effect.

capabilities.name: Historical and new KAE evolution cycles
capabilities.plain_language: The exact KAE exporter and EvoGen strict-envelope boundary are now available; the replay showcase, historical evolution, and supervised live proof remain queued.
capabilities.not_proven: G14 proves a portable export contract only; no public replay showcase, evolved capability, or live world effect has been retained.

capabilities.name: OpenTTD subject environment
capabilities.plain_language: Will provide a pinned, deterministic, headless second environment with causal command lifecycles and a narrow road-freight surface.
capabilities.not_proven: The local OpenTTD installation is an input, not proof of the planned environment. G30 stays blocked until both supervised live KAE work and deferred scientific depth close.

capabilities.name: Two-subject genericity
capabilities.plain_language: Will prove that one CLI and artifact layout operate both KAE and OpenTTD without leaking either subject's ontology into EvoGen core.
capabilities.not_proven: Cross-subject generality remains withheld until G46–G49.

demo_result.label: Deterministic microworld retention proof
demo_result.scope: Portable and hosted evidence; not a live-game claim.

commands.label: Inspect the bundled subject
commands.command: uv run evogen subject doctor microworld

withheld_claims: No general model has yet been shown to infer arbitrary missing capabilities from arbitrary environments.
The KAE generation manifest does not prove that native bytes are loaded, identify a running process, or prove a world effect.
KAE's production trajectory exporter is available, but KAE is not yet registered as an EvoGen subject and no replay showcase or evolved capability is retained.
No OpenTTD subject repository or retained OpenTTD capability exists yet.
Two-subject genericity and the first serious release remain unproven.
